constraints: Returns a nil (non-significant) pointer if there is no form being displayed/printed in the current process, or if the current form is a project form (project forms are not attached to a table).
If several windows are open for the current process, the command applies to the form displayed in the active (last-opened) window.

If the current form is the Detail form of a double-clicked subform area, the command returns the pointer to the table shown in the subform area, or a non-significant pointer if the subform area displays a subtable instead of a table.
